description: This file contains functions and logic for handling agent command delivery, including payload normalization, delivery plan resolution, and message sending via channels. It manages reply payloads, delivery options, and logging for agent commands within an OpenClaw project.

methods.name: formatNestedLogPrefix
methods.description: Constructs a log prefix string for nested agent logs based on provided options and session key.

methods.name: logNestedOutput
methods.description: Logs each line of output with a nested log prefix, splitting output by lines.

methods.name: normalizeAgentCommandReplyPayloads
methods.description: Normalizes reply payloads for agent commands, applying channel transforms and plugin-specific transformations.

methods.name: deliverAgentCommandResult
methods.description: Handles delivery of agent command results, including payload normalization, delivery plan resolution, and message sending with error handling and logging.
